**Log**
Please attach `opentyrian.log`. On Windows it is in `%APPDATA%\OpenTyrian2000`
(type that in File Explorer's address bar); on Linux and the Steam Deck in
`~/.config/opentyrian2000`. If the game folder has an `opentyrian.cfg`, the
log is in the game folder.

Anexe o `opentyrian.log`. No Windows ele fica em `%APPDATA%\OpenTyrian2000`
(digite isso na barra de endereço do Explorador de Arquivos); no Linux e no
Steam Deck, em `~/.config/opentyrian2000`. Se a pasta do jogo tiver um
`opentyrian.cfg`, o log fica na pasta do jogo.
